segments.segment_summary: A person opens a door and a merle-colored dog runs out of a garage into a snowy area, running up a path in the snow.

key_moments.caption: A person opens a door, and a dog is seen running out from inside.
The dog, which has a black and white merle coat, stands in the snow, looking around.
The dog runs up a path through the deep snow.

segments.segment_summary: A man in a beanie and jacket stands outside in a snowy landscape, talking to the camera about the extremely cold weather from the previous day and his plans to clear snow before attending a football game.

key_moments.caption: A wide shot shows a snowy yard with a blue ATV parked next to a garage, with silos visible in the background.
A selfie-style shot of a man in a black beanie and brown jacket talking about the previous day's freezing temperatures.
The man gestures towards the garage while explaining why he didn't use his tractor in the cold.
The man discusses his plans to go to a Vikings vs. Bears football game with his son.
He explains the urgency of moving the snow today before the temperature rises, which would make the snow heavy and difficult to move.
